sentences_to_rerecord: So, this is about Lamp Week and the oversell from last year, and I looked at the incident and the feature and the budget.

accuracy.anchor: Cause, reproduction, re-plan, proof and review stated; the Lumen ACU limit protecting Trailhead and the negative-stock monitor never said (anchor: 22–25 = five of seven points).

structure.anchor: Update has Outcome, Evidence and Ask but no Risk or Next action; framing opens with background (anchor: 14–17 = parts findable, order broken).

customer_relevance.anchor: The Friday deadline appears late; the budget change is acknowledged but its cost to Lumen is never quantified (anchor: 10–13 = outcome present but buried).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing and T+90 over, update and two objections under; six fillers in 11.2 minutes, one tag question, one 11-second pause (anchor: 7–9 = several segments off target).

recovery.anchor: Objection 2 held the pattern; objections 1 and 3 needed the follow-up and still gave no number or named catch with evidence (anchor: 5–6 = pattern partly held).

stems: "Lamp Week is safe from overselling; here is the proof." — lead with the outcome, not with the history.
"I cut X; that saves N ACU and costs Lumen Y." — answer a budget question with two numbers.
"If it happens again, the alert pages the on-call within a minute." — name who wakes up and how.
